about: Model attributes used ONLY to describe what datasets reward (never to rank models). 'family' links size / version variants of one method; 'size_tier' is 0 nano/atto, 1 tiny, 2 small, 3 base, 4 large, 5 huge; 'sar_pretrained' says whether the pretraining data include SAR. Curated 2026-11-10 from the models' own papers and repositories as a first pass; null = not established. To be verified before any use in a paper. 'pretraining' is the main pretraining imagery (high-resolution RGB / multispectral optical such as Sentinel-2 or HLS / multi-sensor including SAR); same first-pass status.
